text: Once there was a little cat. The cat saw a red ball. It played with the ball and went home.
Tom had a small boat. He put it in the pond. The boat sailed away and Tom smiled.
A bird lived in a tall tree. It sang each morning. One day another bird came to sing too.
Lily found a blue box. Inside was a toy bear. She took the bear home and gave it a hug.
The sun was warm. Ben and his dog walked to the park. They ran and played until it was time to eat.
A little fox was hungry. It found an apple under a tree. The fox ate the apple and fell asleep.
Mia made a cake with her dad. They mixed flour and milk. The cake was sweet and everyone was happy.
Sam lost his hat in the wind. A kind girl found it near the gate. Sam thanked her and put it on.
A rabbit saw rain outside. It waited in its house. When the rain stopped it went to the garden.
Eva planted a seed. She gave it water each day. Soon a green leaf grew and Eva was glad.
